annotations.title: Real people who will pray for you

description: Return the door on living-bread.org where real believers will pray for a person by name, and how many distinct people prayed through The Living Bread in the last 24 hours (a live public count, never names or places). Use when a person asks for prayer ("please pray for me", "can someone pray for my mother", "I need prayer"). This tool does not pray and must never be described as praying; it connects a person to people who will. Not for a written prayer to read (a_prayer_for), for asking the family as a signed in member (bring_what_i_carry on /me), for talking with a person now (someone_to_talk_to), or for danger: if the person may harm themselves or others use crisis_resources first. No inputs. Returns the door, sign_in_needed with sign_in_truth (posting a request needs a free account; there is no guest form that reaches people), begin, a page to listen to believers praying aloud now without an account, and prayed_last_24h (null when the live count cannot be read). Reads a live count from the house database; writes nothing. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.
name: real_people_will_pray

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

begin.description: Page to create the free account.

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

door.description: Page where a request for prayer reaches real believers.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

listen_now_without_an_account.description: Page to hear believers praying aloud now, no account needed.

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

prayed_last_24h.description: Distinct people who prayed for someone in the window, with its time; null when the live count is unavailable.

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

sign_in_needed.description: True: posting a request needs a free account.

sign_in_truth.description: Plain sentence explaining what the account is for and that there is no guest form.

this_tool_prays.description: Always false: the tool connects to people, it does not pray.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

title: Real people who will pray for you
